韩国与 30 个国家和地区签订打工度假协议，允许青年在韩停留 12 个月并以兼职: Korea has working holiday agreements with 30 countries and regions, allowing young people to stay up to 12 months and top up travel funds with part-time work. The age ceiling differs by partner: Taiwan 18-34, Hong Kong 18-30. ⚠️ Mainland China is not on the official partner list.
官方总则写 18-30 周岁（含），但同页按国别另表：中国台湾 18-34、中国: The general rule states 18-30 inclusive, but the same page carries a per-country table: Taiwan 18-34, Hong Kong 18-30, Japan 18-25, Canada/Finland/France/Luxembourg/UK 18-35, Argentina/Brazil/Chile/Denmark/Germany/Ireland/Latvia/Portugal 18-34. This record takes the wider of the two eligible passport types verified here (Taiwan, 34); Hong Kong remains 18-30.
官方未设学历门槛，只把「在读证明或最高学历证明」（Proof of studen: The official source sets no education threshold; it only lists proof of student status or highest academic qualifications among the required documents. Whether an individual embassy adds a requirement is decided locally and could not be verified.
官方原文：sufficient funds to support yoursel: Official wording: sufficient funds to support yourself for the initial period of your holiday (KRW 3,000,000 minimum). The old note requiring the bank statement to be issued within one week before applying had no official source and has been removed.
官方未规定存款证明的开具时限、账户持有人或流水时长；此类细节由各使领馆决定，未能: The official source sets no rule on how recent the bank statement must be, whose account it is, or how long the balance must be held. Such details are decided by each embassy and could not be verified.
官方申请材料列有 Medical certificate（健康诊断书）。旧记录里: The official document list includes a medical certificate. The old note naming HIV, drug and chest X-ray tests had no official source and has been removed; the actual tests are specified by each embassy and could not be verified.
官方资格条件写 Not have criminal record，申请材料列 C: The official eligibility criteria state "Not have criminal record", and the document list includes a criminal record check. The old note requiring it to be issued within six months and not notarised had no official source and has been removed; the validity window is set by each embassy and could not be verified.
官方原文：Health Insurance which remains vali: Official wording: health insurance which remains valid throughout your stay in Korea (coverage: KRW 40,000,000 minimum). The euro conversion carried in the old record has been removed rather than estimating an exchange rate.
官方 2026/27 表按国别列出年度名额：中国台湾 800、中国香港 1000: The official 2026/27 table lists annual quotas by partner: Taiwan 800, Hong Kong 1,000, Canada 12,000, UK 5,000, Japan 10,000, USA 2,000, France 2,000, New Zealand 3,000; Australia, Denmark, Germany and Sweden are unlimited. Mainland China is not among the 30 partner countries and regions.
⚠️ 未核实。官方主源（WHIC 总则页与 2026-2027 手册）均未公布: ⚠️ Not verified. Neither official source (the WHIC general page or the 2026-2027 handbook) publishes an H-1 processing time; both tell applicants to check with the embassy, consulate or KVAC in their jurisdiction. The old "about 7 working days" figure had no official source and has been removed.
官方材料清单第一项；具体表格版本与打印要求由各使领馆指定，未能核实。: The first item on the official document list. The exact form version and printing requirements are set by each embassy and could not be verified.
官方原文：hold a valid passport issued by one: Official wording: hold a valid passport issued by one of our partner countries or regions that is valid for at least a year. One passport photo, 3.5cm x 4.5cm, is also required.
官方材料清单列 Criminal record check；开具时限由各使领馆决: The official document list includes a criminal record check. Its validity window is set by each embassy and could not be verified.
须覆盖整个停留期，保额不低于 4,000 万韩元（KRW 40,000,000: Must cover the whole stay, with coverage of at least KRW 40,000,000
官方材料清单项；格式与语言要求由各使领馆指定，未能核实。: Listed on the official document checklist. Format and language requirements are set by each embassy and could not be verified.
对已核到的中国香港与中国台湾护照持有人，官方未公布延长条款，按不可续签处理。例外: For the Hong Kong and Taiwan passport holders verified here, no extension clause is published, so this record treats the visa as non-extendable. Exceptions: US nationals may extend up to 6 months, UK nationals up to 1 year, and Canadian nationals may take part twice (up to 24 months each time).
需特定资格的专业职业（医生、外语讲师、运动员、演艺人员等）: Professions requiring specific qualifications (doctors, foreign-language instructors, athletes, entertainers and similar)
每周最多工作 25 小时（官方原文：maximum working hours:: At most 25 hours of work per week (official wording: maximum working hours 25 hours/week); Canadian nationals are exempt and may work 40 hours per week, 2,080 hours per year. Same-employer and study caps vary by partner: Hong Kong is 6 months for each; Taiwan has no limit on either; Australia is 6 months with the same employer and 4 months of study. The old "1,300 hours per year" figure was derived from 25 x 52 and is not an official statement, so it has been removed.
⚠️ 关键信息：韩国外交部（在外同胞厅 WHIC）官方公布的 30 个签约国家/: ⚠️ Key point: the official 30-partner list published by Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (WHIC, Overseas Koreans Agency) for 2026/27 does not include mainland China, so mainland Chinese passport holders cannot apply. The old sentence claiming Korean missions in China serve "Austrian nationals only" has been removed: it came from reading the Sydney consulate URL prefix "au-sydney-en" as Austria (au = Australia), which was a misreading and irrelevant to this conclusion anyway.
